verdict.rationale: Amplitude's SDK docs say it auto-instruments page views and clicks out of the box, which covers the core of no-code event capture. Form interactions, the third element of the story, are never mentioned, and the claim rests on a single brief line. Missing for 10: documented automatic capture of form interactions, in-depth autocapture configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can capture clicks, pageviews, and form interactions automatically without writing tracking code for each event

citations.quote: Auto-instrument page views, clicks, and sessions out of the box.
Aggregate click, scroll, and selector data across sessions into visual maps of user engagement.
